text:
Anya: Quick sync — need a decision on how we split the next two sprints between bug weight vs feature velocity after GA. Acme has an embedding regression + two other P1s. I'm proposing 60% bug / 40% feature for the next 2 sprints. Thoughts? :thinking:
Mario: Can you paste the P1 list and rough eng estimates? hard to agree to 60/40 without numbers.
Shilpi: From infra: the streaming p99 spike is real, affects customers on Dedicated. I can share the dashboard (link). triage-bot: new P1 logged -> acme-embed-regression (sev=P1). Total open P1s = 3.
Cody: I'm leaning 50/50. We have 2 small features (onboarding tweaks) that drop churn; delaying them could increase CS work. Also customers asked for the batching opt for cost.
Anya: OK quick rubric I used: severity * customer impact + rollback risk. My proposal: prioritize all P1s and one small QoL feature; freeze the rest of non-critical features for the two-sprint window.
Anya: Quick list (estimates):
```
P1: acme-embed-regression - 8d
P1: streaming-p99-spike - 5d
P2: ui-copy-glitch - 1d
Feature: onboarding-flow (small) - 3d
Feature: batching-opt - 6d
```
Mario: With that, 60/40 gets acme + streaming done and we can sneak onboarding. Batching moves out. I can defer onboarding only if CS agrees. Need to message sales.
Shilpi: Ops note — we can try a hotfix/canary for acme embed to reduce customer disruption. That would shave ~2d off the full fix risk if it validates.
Cody: +1 to canary. Also suggest we run a quick eval (embedding drift) after the patch to ensure quality isn't degraded by the fix/quant change. I can own the eval tests.
Anya: Decision (tentative): move to 60% bug focus for 2 sprints, prioritize P1s, allow 1 small QoL ticket (onboarding). I'll tag affected tickets with `postlaunch-prio` and update the roadmap board. I'll draft a short note for CS + sales.
Mario: I'll ping @sales and @cs about potential impact and timing. Also scheduling a 30m grooming tomorrow 10:00 to re-estimate the feature backlog so we have firm numbers.
triage-bot: deploy update -> patch for acme embed is in canary (verification pending).
Anya: Thanks everyone. If the canary looks good, we push full fix early next week. If not, we'll revert to the rollback playbook and reassess. :thumbsup:
Cody: I'll post the eval results in the thread once complete.
Shilpi: I'll monitor infra metrics and drop alerts in #eng-oncall if anything regresses.
Mario: Logged an internal one-pager for CS to send to affected customers. Will share link here after it's formatted.
Anya: sweet — closing this check-in. Follow-ups: Mario -> sales ping, Cody -> eval, Shilpi -> infra watch, Anya -> roadmap + ticket tags.
